about: Every place in app/ that branches on the database engine or names SQLite. Each entry is marked safe (correct on SQLite and MySQL 8.4) or to-fix (must change before the MySQL cutover). Checked by tests/Unit/DatabaseDialectGuardTest.php.

branches.text: $pdo = new PDO('sqlite:'.$path, null, null, [PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION, PDO::SQLITE_ATTR_OPEN_FLAGS => PDO::SQLITE_OPEN_READONLY]);
branches.reason: SQLite-only by design: it reads a SQLite safety backup. --apply refuses unless the live database is SQLite (H-1); the dry run uses the live connection.
